# @amykit/plugin-claude

The claude CLI as the agent, over its JSON envelope.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides `claude` in the `harness` collection and `Claude` in the `usage` collection.

Use it when the agent should be Claude Code, run through the claude CLI. It contributes a harness and a usage reader to agent-relay instead of mounting the agent port itself, so install agent-relay with it, and list codex or hermes-agent too when the relay should have somewhere to fall back. Claude reports what each run cost, so a ceiling in money works without a row in the price table.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | _none_ |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-claude
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-claude"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-claude":
    model: ""
    models: []
    permissionMode: "acceptEdits"
    timeoutMs: 1800000
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `model` | `string` | no | `""` | passed to the CLI as --model, which is the flag it accepts |
| `models` | `string[]` | no | `[]` | the model tiers to offer the relay, cheapest first. One agent is contributed per tier, named `claude:<model>`. Empty means a single agent using `model` |
| `permissionMode` | `string` | no | `acceptEdits` | passed to the CLI as --permission-mode on a run that may write: `acceptEdits`, `auto` or `bypassPermissions`. A read-only run is always `plan` |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | no | `1800000` | how long one agent call may run before it is given up on |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.

## Environment

This package reads the following, which `amy doctor` checks for you:

| Variable |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | required at mount |
